description: 《Telephone》描寫一個人厭倦了不斷被電話打擾，渴望暫時擺脫外界壓力、盡情享受自由的心情。歌中的主角正在夜店與朋友狂歡，卻接連收到對方的來電，令她感到煩躁與不耐。她以訊號不良、手拿酒杯等理由拒絕回應，希望將所有煩惱拋諸腦後，專心投入音樂與舞蹈。歌曲以幽默、誇張的方式呈現現代生活中隨時保持聯繫的壓力，而不斷響起的電話則象徵外界對個人時間的干擾。最終，《Telephone》傳達的是自由、自主與享受當下的精神：每個人都需要屬於自己的空間，偶爾放下手機與外界的期待，才能真正放鬆心情，重新掌握生活的節奏。

vocabulary.usage: 在地下室、山區等地方手機沒有訊號時，可以說 My phone has no service。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「no service」表示手機沒有訊號？
options: The hotel has no service, so the guests must make their own beds.
My phone has no service in the tunnel, so I can't call you.
The cake has no service because it has not worked here for a year.
The sign says, “No service.” All the chairs must leave the building.
optionExplanations: 這裡的 service 是旅館服務，不是手機訊號；這句英文在另一個意思下可以成立，但不符合本題要考的用法。
在隧道裡手機收不到訊號，所以不能打電話，正確。
把 service 當成蛋糕的工作年資；可說 The cake has been in the shop for a year.
「停止服務」不表示椅子被要求離開大樓；可說 The office is closed today.
vocabulary.explanation: 在隧道裡手機收不到訊號，所以不能打電話，正確。

vocabulary.usage: 通話時聽不清楚對方的聲音，可說 You're breaking up。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「breaking up」描述通話？
options: The glass is breaking up with the floor because they had an argument.
My radio is breaking up a birthday cake for six people.
The company is breaking up with Tuesday. It will only work on Wednesday.
You're breaking up. Please move closer to the window.
optionExplanations: 玻璃和地板沒有交往關係；可說 The glass fell on the floor and broke.
break up 有「拆散、分成小部分」的其他用法，但收音機不會替人分蛋糕，也不是本題要考的通話用法；可說 We cut the cake into six pieces.
把 break up 當成「分手」，還讓公司和星期二結束感情；可說 The company will be closed on Tuesday.
聲音斷斷續續，請對方移到窗邊，符合電話通話的語境。
vocabulary.explanation: 聲音斷斷續續，請對方移到窗邊，符合電話通話的語境。

vocabulary.meaning: 有點忙；kinda 是 kind of 的口語寫法。
vocabulary.usage: 和朋友輕鬆說自己目前沒空，可說 I'm kinda busy。
options: The lift is kinda busy because it is wearing a suit today.
Please kinda busy this letter before six o'clock.
I'm kinda busy right now. Can we talk after dinner?
My new job is kinda busy: I count the same empty room every hour.
optionExplanations: 穿西裝並不是電梯「有點忙」的原因；可說 The lift is full of people today.
kinda busy 不能當成「處理信件」的動詞；可說 Please send this letter before six o'clock.
說明現在忙，並提出晚餐後再談的時間，使用自然。
工作可能讓人忙，但「每小時數同一間空房間」不一定構成忙碌；這句本身不一定文法錯，但不是清楚合理的使用例子。可說 My new job keeps me busy all day.
vocabulary.explanation: 說明現在忙，並提出晚餐後再談的時間，使用自然。

vocabulary.usage: 請別人短暫等待時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「just a second」表示「請稍等」？
options: Just a second, please. I need to put down these bags.
I am just a second in the race, so I won a silver medal.
The museum keeps just a second in a glass box. Visitors may not touch time.
The ticket office gave me just a second because the first second was late.
optionExplanations: 手上拿著袋子，請對方稍等，使用正確。
要說比賽第二名，應說 I came second in the race.；just a second 在本題是請人等待。
博物館不能把「稍等一下」收藏在玻璃盒裡；可說 The museum keeps old clocks in a glass box.
把「一秒鐘」當成售票處可以補發的東西；可說 The ticket office gave me a new ticket.
vocabulary.explanation: 手上拿著袋子，請對方稍等，使用正確。

vocabulary.usage: 用手機傳訊息給朋友，可以說 text + 人。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「text」作為「傳訊息」的動詞？
options: The library texts its silence every morning to make sure it is still quiet.
I'll text you when the train arrives.
The new law says all trees must text the city before they grow taller.
Please text the window blue. The paint is next to the door.
optionExplanations: 安靜不是會讀訊息的收件人；可說 The library is quiet every morning.
火車抵達時傳訊息給對方，正確。
法律不會要求樹木長高前傳訊息；可說 The city has rules about planting trees.
text 不是「油漆」；可說 Please paint the window blue.
vocabulary.explanation: 火車抵達時傳訊息給對方，正確。

vocabulary.usage: 約好見面時間或安排活動時使用。
options: The dentist looked at my plans and said they needed two new teeth.
The baker made plans with sugar, but they tasted too sweet.
We made plans to visit our grandparents on Sunday.
The weather made plans for Saturday. The sun has to ask for a day off.
optionExplanations: 牙醫不會替計畫補牙；可說 The dentist looked at my teeth.
這裡把 plans 當成可以加糖試吃的食物；可說 The baker made cookies with sugar.
事先安排星期日去看祖父母，正確。
天氣沒有請假制度；可說 The weather will be sunny on Saturday.
vocabulary.explanation: 事先安排星期日去看祖父母，正確。

vocabulary.meaning: 不停打電話或傳訊息，讓手機一直響。
vocabulary.usage: 某人在短時間內一直聯絡你時使用，並不是手機真的爆炸。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「blow up my phone」表示不停聯絡？
options: Please don't blow up my phone with messages while I'm asleep.
The fire station told me to blow up my phone before the safety test.
The phone shop blew up my phone, and now it is twice as big.
The news says my phone blew up the whole city because it was angry.
optionExplanations: 請對方在自己睡覺時不要一直傳訊息，符合口語片語的意思。
消防單位不會要求民眾把手機吹起來；可說 The fire station told us to turn off our phones.
這裡誤把 blow up 當成「把手機吹大」；可說 The phone shop gave me a bigger phone.
這裡把片語當成手機因為生氣而炸掉整座城市；可說 My phone kept ringing during the news.
vocabulary.explanation: 請對方在自己睡覺時不要一直傳訊息，符合口語片語的意思。

vocabulary.meaning: 對某件事厭煩透了、受夠了。
vocabulary.usage: 某事不斷發生而讓人很不耐煩，可用 be sick and tired of + 名詞／V-ing。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「sick and tired of」？
options: I'm sick and tired of hearing the same alarm every morning.
The doctor gave the chair some medicine because it was sick and tired of sitting.
My cold is sick and tired of me. It wants to find a new person.
The office is sick and tired, so every worker must bring it soup.
optionExplanations: 對每天早上聽到同一個鬧鐘聲感到厭煩，使用正確。
把 sick 和 tired 認真當成椅子的病症；可說 The chair is old and uncomfortable.
把感冒當成想換主人的房客；可說 I have had a cold for several days.
辦公室這個地方不是會生病、需要喝湯的人；可說 The workers are tired after a busy day.
vocabulary.explanation: 對每天早上聽到同一個鬧鐘聲感到厭煩，使用正確。

vocabulary.meaning: 像催收員一樣（一直追著打電話）。
vocabulary.usage: 歌中的 collector 指的很可能是催收欠款的人；用來誇張形容對方來電太頻繁。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「like a collector」來形容催收式的來電？
options: The sea called like a collector because the beach owed it three waves.
The art gallery called like a collector because it wanted another painting.
The clock called like a collector to ask for the minutes I lost yesterday.
He called me ten times today, like a collector asking for money.
optionExplanations: 海灘不會欠大海三個浪，也不會接到催收電話；可說 Three big waves hit the beach.
美術館想收藏更多畫作，是 collector 的另一種意思，不是本題「催收式來電」。
時鐘不會打電話討回失去的分鐘；可說 The clock is five minutes slow.
一天打十通電話，像催收員追著要錢，符合歌曲語境。
vocabulary.explanation: 一天打十通電話，像催收員追著要錢，符合歌曲語境。

vocabulary.usage: 說某人現在能否接電話時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「take calls」表示接聽電話？
options: The airport takes calls in small bags and sends them to other countries.
The doctor can't take calls now because she's with a patient.
I take calls to the gym because they need exercise.
The menu says that calls are free, but you must eat them in the restaurant.
optionExplanations: 把來電當成機場可以打包托運的物品；可說 The airport takes phone calls from passengers.
醫師正在看診，無法接聽電話，正確。
來電不是需要運動的東西；可說 I take my phone to the gym.
把電話當成餐廳菜單上的食物；可說 The restaurant offers free drinks.
vocabulary.context: 教學提醒：：部分錯誤選項刻意使用不同詞義（例如 service、collector）；這些句子在別的語境可能是正常英文，但不符合本題指定的意思。可先讓學生辨認誤用，再看繁體中文解說。笑點有時來自看似正式、卻完全不合理的規定或推論；不必額外解釋「為什麼好笑」。
vocabulary.explanation: 醫師正在看診，無法接聽電話，正確。
